title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice (Fourth Revision)
scope: Code of practice covering general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete, including design (working stress and limit state methods), materials, workmanship, inspection and testing.
department: Cement and Concrete Sectional Committee, CED 2

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel — Specification (Seventh Revision)
scope: Covers requirements of steel including micro-alloyed steel plates, strips, shapes, sections (angles, tees, beams, channels), flats and bars for structural work suitable for welded, bolted and riveted structures.
department: Wrought Steel Products Sectional Committee, MTD 04
status: Seventh Revision. Note: BIS circular (16 Apr 2026) indicates IS 2062 is being split into Part 1 (hot rolled medium/high tensile) and Part 2 (quenched & tempered); IS 2062:2011 stands withdrawn after implementation of IS 2062(Part 1):2025

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement — Specification (Fourth Revision)
scope: Covers requirements of deformed steel bars and wires (TMT bars) used as reinforcement in concrete, in strength grades Fe415/Fe500/Fe500D/Fe550/Fe550D/Fe600.
department: Concrete Reinforcement Sectional Committee, CED 54

title: Ordinary Portland Cement — Specification (Fifth Revision)
scope: Covers manufacture and chemical/physical requirements of Ordinary Portland Cement, consolidating grades 33, 43 and 53 (previously separate IS 269, IS 8112, IS 12269) plus sleeper-grade cement for railway concrete sleepers.
department: Cement and Concrete Sectional Committee, CED 2
status: Fifth Revision | Reviewed in 2020; Mandatory Certification (confirmed on official page). Ministry: Housing and Urban Affairs / DPIIT.

title: Plywood for Concrete Shuttering Works — Specification (Third Revision)
scope: Covers the requirements of plywood for concrete shuttering and form work (formwork plywood reused across multiple concrete pours in RCC construction).
department: Wood and Other Lignocellulosic Products Sectional Committee, CED 20
status: Third Revision | WITHDRAWN — superseded by IS 4990:2024 (Fourth Revision). Implementation deadline for the new standard was 26 Dec 2024, after which IS 4990:2011 stood withdrawn, per an official BIS circular.

title: Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Safety Part 1: General Requirements (Seventh Revision) / IEC 60335-1:2020
scope: General safety requirements and constructional details for household and similar electrical appliances (voltage not exceeding 250V single-phase / 480V other), covering electrical and mechanical construction aspects affecting safety, durability and reliability.
department: Electrotechnical Department
status: Seventh Revision; running concurrently with IS 302(Part1):2008 until 23 Feb 2026

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services: Part 1 Safety Requirements
scope: Safety requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps intended for general lighting services on supplies up to 250V.
department: Lamps and Related Equipments Committee, ETD 23
status: Original 2012 edition; First Revision published as IS 16102(Part1):2026

title: Rotating Electrical Machines — Specification
scope: Identical under dual numbering with the 1988-era IEC 60034-3 'Specific requirements for turbine-type synchronous machines' — applies to large three-phase turbine-type synchronous machines (generators) with rated outputs of 10 MVA and above.
department: Rotating Machinery Sectional Committee, ETD 15
status: Likely superseded: the current IEC 60034-3 content area (synchronous generators driven by steam/gas turbines) appears to now be carried under IS 15999 (Part 3):2023, which is 'Identical under dual numbering' with the current IEC 60034-3:2020 — confirm directly with BIS/Babar's team before treating IS 4722:2001 as the live standard.

title: Information Technology Equipment — Safety Part 1: General Requirements (Second Revision) / IEC 60950-1:2005
scope: Safety requirements for IT equipment (servers, workstations, laptops, networking devices, storage systems, peripherals) operating on voltages up to 600V, covering electric shock, fire and mechanical hazards.
department: Electronics and Information Technology Department, LITD 7

title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated (Unsheathed and Sheathed) Cables/Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductor for Rated Voltages up to and including 1100 V (Fourth Revision)
scope: General requirements for single and multicore cables/cords with rigid or flexible annealed bare/tinned copper or aluminium conductors, PVC insulated (with or without sheath), for rated voltages up to and including 1100 V — used for internal wiring and household/industrial low-voltage applications.
department: NULL

title: Safety of Toys — Part 1: Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties (Fourth Revision) / ISO 8124-1:2018
scope: Requirements and test methods for toys intended for use by children from birth to 14 years, covering structural characteristics (shape, size, contour, spacing) and toy-category-specific safety criteria.
department: Toys and Related Test Methods Sectional Committee, PCD 30

title: Personal Protective Equipment Part 2: Safety Footwear (Third Revision) / ISO 20345:2021, MOD
scope: Specification for safety footwear providing toe protection and other protective features, modified/technically equivalent to ISO 20345:2021.
department: Committee CHD 19 (Leather and Leather Products)

title: Domestic Pressure Cooker — Specification (Sixth Revision)
scope: Covers requirements for domestic pressure cookers of nominal capacity up to 24 litres, including aluminium, stainless steel, hard-anodized, induction-compatible, composite-bottom and 3-ply type cookers.
department: Utensils, Cutlery and Domestic Hardware Sectional Committee, MED 33
status: Sixth Revision | REVISED — IS 2347:2017 has been superseded by IS 2347:2023 (Seventh Revision). Implementation deadline for the revised standard was 28 March 2024, per an official BIS circular. Treat IS 2347:2017 as historical unless the team specifically needs the older edition.

title: Drinking Water — Specification (Second Revision)
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for drinking water, defining 'Acceptable Limit' and 'Permissible Limit (in absence of alternate source)' for physical, chemical, bacteriological and radiological parameters.
department: NULL

title: Packaged Drinking Water (Other Than Packaged Natural Mineral Water) — Specification (Second Revision)
scope: Covers quality, packaging and labelling requirements for packaged drinking water sold in India, other than packaged natural mineral water (which is separately covered by IS 13428/IS 14543's sibling standard).
department: NULL

title: Polyethylene Pipes for Water Supply — Specification (Fifth Revision)
scope: Covers requirements for high-density polyethylene (HDPE) pipes intended for potable water supply, including material, dimensional and pressure-rating requirements; identical/equivalent scope area to ISO 4427.
department: Not available on reviewed BIS page (sub-group per official classification: 'PE pipes, Fittings and their testing')

title: Unplasticized PVC Pipes for Potable Water Supplies — Specification (Fourth Revision)
scope: Covers requirements for unplasticized PVC (uPVC) pipes intended for conveying potable water under pressure, including lead-free material composition, dimensions, pressure classes, and physical/mechanical test requirements.
department: Plastic Piping System Sectional Committee, CED 50

title: Iodized Salt, Vacuum Evaporated Iodized Salt and Refined Iodized Salt — Specification (Second Revision)
scope: Covers requirements for common salt fortified with iodine (iodized salt) intended for human consumption, including vacuum-evaporated and refined iodized salt grades.
department: NULL

title: Containers for Packaging of Natural Mineral Water and Packaged Drinking Water — Specification
scope: Covers requirements for containers (bottles/jars, typically PET or similar) used to package natural mineral water and packaged drinking water, including material safety, dimensional and performance/leakage-test requirements.
department: NULL

title: Carbon Steel Cast Billet Ingots, Billets, Blooms and Slabs for Re-Rolling into Steel for General Structural Purposes — Specification (Third Revision)
scope: Covers requirements for cast carbon-steel billet ingots, billets, blooms and slabs intended for re-rolling into finished steel products for general structural purposes.
department: NULL

title: Random Sampling and Randomization Procedures (First Revision) / ISO 24153:2009
scope: Cornerstone standard for random sampling and randomization procedures used across industrial quality control, trade and scientific applications; identical to ISO 24153:2009. Supersedes the original IS 4905:1968.
department: Statistical Methods for Quality and Reliability Sectional Committee, MSD 03

title: Sampling Procedures for Inspection by Attributes: Part 1 Sampling Schemes Indexed by Acceptance Quality Limit (AQL) for Lot-by-Lot Inspection (Third Revision) / ISO 2859-1:1999
scope: Acceptance sampling plans indexed by Acceptable Quality Level (AQL) — specifies how many units to inspect from a lot and the acceptance/rejection criteria; identical to ISO 2859-1:1999.
department: Statistical Methods for Quality, Data Analytics and Reliability Sectional Committee, MSD 03
